The series design, its decision rule, its stop rule, the grading rules and this pass condition are all fixed in that contract's §The 2026-10-07 sixth series before d1; the section's sha256 is recorded in the chunk's `evidence/attempt-ledger.md` before d1 fires and is recomputed by the `real_model_harvest` target (`crates/conductor-run/tests/real_model_grading/series_2026_10_07_sixth.rs`), so an edit after the series fails. A drive whose preflight canary forms no incident is a canary measurement. It is recorded with its classification and never graded. A drive whose scenario emitted and was read back is graded.

The capability is met iff at least one drive is graded AND every graded drive's pinned outcome is `Identified` under the unchanged rule: the attributed incident's rank-1 hypothesis statement names `conductor` as a whole word and a retry token (`retry` / `retries` / `retrying`), case-insensitively. The real-model witnesses must also hold for each graded drive: Pulse's `interpretation.model.load` reads `inference_mode = real`, and the attributed report carries no `det-` evidence ref. A separate ref test, written only when this condition holds, asserts both over the committed captures. A graded `NotIdentified` outcome means NOT met; it is recorded, and no further drive replaces it (no retry-until-pass). This is the last series for `v3-09` in 0.3.0, by the founder's ruling of 2026-10-07, fixed in the series section before d1: a series that does not meet the condition is not followed by another, and the capability then leaves 0.3.0 unmet.

Stated limit, restated for Pulse `9bfefb8` (prompt `v2.6`, unchanged since `f70be92`): the cue line reaches the model verbatim and carries both facets of the rule, and both stay instructed. The digest's `TRIGGER: Retry storm` line names the cause and no scope, and the prompt obliges the first hypothesis statement to name that signal in the line's own words and to name the cue line's `scope_id` value exactly as written, not a service whose name merely contains it. What `9bfefb8` changes is the digest's corpus block: under a triggering cue that carries a `scope_id` it keeps that scope's own incidents and drops other scopes', unless the fingerprint arm keeps them. So `Identified` means the shipped model followed both instructions over a cue line that carries both verbatim, on a digest narrowed to the triggering scope. It is not inference of an unstated cause. A statement that names `conductor` as a whole word and also names the canary service grades `Identified`: the rule reads the words, not where the statement places the storm, and it is left unchanged for 0.3.0. A met series is three drives and is not read as proof beyond them.
